oracle_facts.name: Celebrate the Mountain-king
oracle_facts.oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, for each opponent, exile up to one target nonland permanent that player controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
When this enchantment enters, recruit. (Draw a card, then discard a card. If you discarded a nonland card, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.)

obligations.spell: Actually paid3W enchantment, two independently ordered entry triggers
obligations.exile: For the only opponent in this two-player library choose up to one nonland permanent they control, reject own/land/player; exact source and target, sourcegone before resolution no exile; target stale/control change invalidates; linked return occurs without stack on departure under owner, fresh ref/token ceases
obligations.recruit: Mandatory separate trigger draws then private discard, nonland yields exact 1/1 white Human Soldier token; land and replaced discards correctly handled, sourcegone still resolves; 0 targets does not suppress recruit
obligations.owned: Raw/index/restore during target and private discard choices; illegal target actions rollback; exact incarnation prevents a stale target from being exiled.
